question: Is the frozen P6AC 16x presampling raster sufficiently converged to a separately rendered 32x reference to serve as an algorithm-selection target?

reference.sample_rule: bilinear average of the four high-resolution samples surrounding each exact target-cell centre

metrics: 16x FFT versus existing 16x spatial maximum absolute error
16x versus 32x RMSE and P95 absolute error

forbidden: change zooms, fixture, geometry, aperture, sampling rule or gates after scoring
fit or extrapolate a convergence correction
use the 32x output inside a product or target compiler
reinterpret failure as permission to tune P6AC or P6AD
claim measured film/scanner convergence, calibration or product quality

branch_rule.pass: Validate 16x as the frozen offline synthetic reference and keep P6AD closed; a future compiler must use a new mechanism and unchanged target.
branch_rule.fail: Revoke 16x as an algorithm-selection target, retain 32x only as provisional offline reference, and require a separately frozen reference-convergence design before new compiler work.

claim_ceiling: Generic synthetic presampling reference-convergence evidence; no measured film, scanner, stock, process, quality or product claim.
